newsitem.title: USA: Panaco buys interests in 6 offshore fields.
newsitem.headline: Panaco buys interests in 6 offshore fields.

text.p: Panaco Inc said Thursday it completed the acquisition of interests in six offshore fields from Amoco Corp's Amoco Production Co for $40.4 million.
It issued to Amoco two million shares of Panaco common stock and the balance in cash.
Panaco said its primary credit facility was increased to $40 million, and an additional $17 million subordinated facility was provided by Kayne, Anderson Investment Management.
Panaco acquired a 33.3 percent working interest in the East Breaks 160 Field and a 33.3 percent stake in the High Island 302 Field, both operated by Unocal Corp.

It acquired a 50 percent interest in the High Island 309 Field, a 12 percent stake in the High Island 330 Field and a 12 percent interest in the High Island 474 Field, all operated by Phillips Petroleum Co.
In addition, Panaco acquired a 12.5 percent stake in the West Cameron 180 Field operated by Texaco Inc.
Current production is 680 BOPD and 14 MMCFD of natural gas.
